name: Biohazard
summary:
Biohazard is a multiplayer VR survival horror experience that plunges players into the heart of an abandoned, overgrown research facility consumed by a mysterious biological outbreak. Wearing full hazmat suits, players must work together—or survive alone—as they explore the rotting structure, gather essential gear, and face nightmarish creatures born from the failed containment of an unknown organic threat.
